definitions.explanation: A deep cooking vessel with handles, used for boiling, stewing, etc.
A type of Japanese dish where ingredients are cooked together in a pot at the table.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きい{鍋|なべ}でスープを{作|つく}ります。
examples.english: I make soup in a large pot.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{晩|ばん}ごはんは{鍋|なべ}です。
{冬|ふゆ}は{鍋料理|なべりょうり}がおいしいです。
examples.english: Hot pot dishes are delicious in winter.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}を{火|ひ}にかけて、お{湯|ゆ}を{沸|わ}かしてください。
examples.english: Put the pot on the stove and boil the water.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}みんなで{鍋|なべ}を{囲|かこ}んで{食|た}べるのは{楽|たの}しいです。
examples.english: It's fun to sit around the hot pot and eat with the whole family.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}を{洗|あら}ってください。
{新|あたら}しい{鍋|なべ}を{買|か}った。
{今夜|こんや}は{鍋|なべ}にしよう。
{鍋|なべ}パーティーを{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: I hosted a hot pot party.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}の{具|ぐ}を{入|い}れてください。
examples.english: Please add the hot pot ingredients.

notes: {鍋|なべ} refers both to the cooking vessel and to hot pot dishes ({鍋料理|なべりょうり}). Popular nabe dishes include すき{焼|や}き (sukiyaki), しゃぶしゃぶ (shabu-shabu), and {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ} (yosenabe). Nabe is a popular winter meal often shared among family or friends.
